# Partnerships & Co-Marketing

`partnerships-and-co-marketing` · v1.0.0 · Execute · Growth, Retention & RevOps
<!-- Generated by platform/scripts/generate-engine-specs.mjs from skills/partnerships-and-co-marketing/spec.json and SKILL.md. Do not edit. -->

**Decision it supports:** Is this company worth partnering with, is the agreement written before work starts, and should we run it again?

**Inputs:** What you want from partners and by when, the candidate partners with their audience and product, who can say yes on each side, and afterwards the leads, pipeline and hours each side spent

**Output:** A partner score with the blockers named, a first approach that leads with what their customers get, the five written terms including lead sharing and consent, a promotion plan with dates, and a repeat/change/stop verdict

**Setup:**
- Install the skill: `npx skills add sarojkjha/aaj-marketing-skills --skill partnerships-and-co-marketing`
- Or connect the hosted MCP server, no install: `https://aaj-engines-mcp.sarojkjha10.workers.dev/mcp`
- Or run the local MCP server: node platform/mcp/server.mjs (Node 18 or newer)
- Input schema: the comment at the top of `skills/partnerships-and-co-marketing/resources/partner-fit.js` (the MCP server's describe_engine shows it). Worked example: `node skills/partnerships-and-co-marketing/resources/partner-fit.js --demo`.
- Agents listed: Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf, Cline. Tested and recorded: Claude Code, OpenAI Codex (Windows, ab-test-significance only).

**Acts or analyzes:** Analyzes only. The engine makes no network calls, writes no files and changes nothing in your tools; it returns text and JSON.

**Where your information goes:**

| How you run it | Where your inputs go |
|---|---|
| Skill installed in your agent, or the local MCP server | The engine runs on your machine and AAJ receives nothing. Your AI agent still sends what you give it to its model provider (Anthropic, OpenAI and so on), under your own account's terms. |
| Hosted MCP server | Your agent's model provider, as above, plus AAJ's server on Cloudflare, which receives the engine inputs over HTTPS, runs them in memory and keeps no copy. Cloudflare keeps error logs (no inputs) for up to 7 days. |

No engine needs customer names, emails or other personal data; leave them out.

**Limitations:**
- Give {check, input} for scorePartner, checkTerms or reviewPartnership; with no input you get a labelled demo. Unknown checks, top-level fields and fields inside input stop the run.
- The score is a rubric of your own 0-3 ratings, not a prediction. It cannot know whether the partner will promote as promised, and inputs you list as unknowns are noted but do not lower the score.
- checkTerms checks that each of the five terms is present, not what it says; any entry passes.
- "Do it again" needs a qualified lead, pipeline, a full sales cycle elapsed and at least 20% of sign-ups qualified. Pipeline before a full cycle reads "Too early to decide"; a thin audience reads "Change the format".

**Review before acting:** The partnership owner checks the overlap and reach ratings against the partner's own data, and both sides sign the lead-sharing and consent terms, before work starts. The review is judged on pipeline after a full sales cycle.
